text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of Winning Ticket's Debut Race has 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer encourages her when she starts 
itching from nervousness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Empowered with courage, Winning Ticket 
blew away her nerves and itchiness and 
headed toward her Make Debut.
